question: Who among the following Indian nationals got the ‘Legion of Merit’ Award 2020 from the US?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi got the ‘Legion of Merit’ Award 2020 from the US**__.

 __
 
• Then US President Donald Trump presented the Legion of Merit award to PM Narendra Modi.
 
• **He had been awarded for his leadership in elevating the strategic partnership of the two countries and the emergence of India as a global power.**
 
• India’s Ambassador to the US, Taranjit Singh Sandhu, accepted the award on behalf of him from the US National Security Advisor Robert O’Brien at the White House.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Legion of Merit award was instituted in 1942 by former U.S President Franklin D. Roosevelt.**

 
 
• It is awarded to members of the U.S. armed forces and also members of foreign armed forces and sometimes heads of state or government.
 
• The 2020 award was also presented to former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe and Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison.
